description: Prove you control the server an agent runs on. Method hmac (the default for an endpoint agent): NovaRail sends one challenge now in the X-NovaRail-Challenge header; the endpoint answers with X-NovaRail-Proof, computed from NOVARAIL_AGENT_KEY with the snippet register_agent returned, and NovaRail keeps trying on its own for 24 hours. Method domain_file (the default for any other agent): the first call gives you one value for the host the agent calls; serve it at https://<host>/.well-known/agentnet-challenge.txt and call again to check it, at most 20 times a day per host. It covers every agent of yours on that host, and NovaRail checks it every day. It is free. Auth: Bearer <NovaRail account key or OAuth token>.

agent_id.description: The agent's id (agent_id from register_agent or my_agents).

method.description: hmac or domain_file. Leave it out for the agent's default.

name: control_proof
title: Prove control
